description: Fetch one Sigstore Rekor transparency-log entry by its integer position in the log, with the base64 body already decoded: entry kind, signed artifact digest, signature, signing certificate, integration timestamp and inclusion proof. Use this to walk the log; use rekor_entry when you have a uuid. Keyless. Example: rekor_entry_by_index({ log_index: 500000 }).

log_index.description: Position in the log, 0 .. tree_size-1. rekor_log_info reports tree_size.

name: rekor_entry_by_index
title: Rekor Entry By Index
